feed.identity_note: The SOS publishes these files for media and automated readers (listing: media.sos.ca.gov/media/json-endpoints.csv, "all available JSON endpoints for the California November 3, 2026 Statewide General Election"). They answered our named User-Agent with 200s on Nov 4, 8:30 to 8:38 AM CT (S3 behind CloudFront, x-cdn: Imperva). The results site electionresults.sos.ca.gov and the api.sos.ca.gov feed sit behind an Incapsula check that refused the Worker on Cloudflare, so we never read them from there; rows link to the results site.
feed.election_id_from: The files name no election. The listing above names the November 3, 2026 Statewide General Election; gubernatorial-general is the id api.sos.ca.gov uses for it (media.sos.ca.gov/media/api-endpoints.csv, read Nov 3 8:23 PM PT). Each read confirms the ballot by its measure numbers (feed.expect_props: 1 to 5 and 37 to 45).
feed.paths_from: One file per contest family from the listing: the eight statewide offices, the two Supreme Court retentions, ballot measures, Board of Equalization and U.S. House. Only each race’s own section is read ("- Statewide Results", "- Districtwide Results"), never a county’s. On Nov 4 at the 6:27 AM PT update every one of the 80 whole-race sections matched api.sos.ca.gov’s count, words and time exactly (both read from a laptop).
